items.coder_A: DLL3 positivity is one alternative entry route, not a strict requirement: DLL3-negative patients with a DLL3-prevalent histology (including GBM) may enrol, so it may not count as an eligibility biomarker.
items.proposed: DLL3 is not an entry requirement: recode exploratory_correlative, candidate_matched true (tarlatamab); candidate_matched_selection false
items.reason: DLL3 IHC is one alternative entry route and is waived for listed histologies: 'If patients are DLL3 negative per IHC but have a DLL3 prevalant tumor type, they will be allowed to enroll'. Glioblastoma multiforme is a listed DLL3-prevalent type, so GBM patients enter without DLL3 testing. §5 counts a biomarker as eligibility only if it is an entry requirement.

items.coder_A: DLL3 positivity is one of several alternative routes to eligibility; DLL3-negative patients with a DLL3-prevalent histology (including GBM) may enrol, so it may not be a true entry requirement.

items.reason: As above; GBM patients may enrol DLL3-negative by histology alone.

Four registered EXPERIMENTAL cohorts (Concurrent Main, Concurrent Cranial, Sequential RT, Tarlatamab Monotherapy) and none is a control. R8 uses not_applicable for single-arm trials; with more than one registered arm, 'no' applies, even though the description says 'Single Arm'.

note: Primary outcome changes from the coders' agreed true to false: DLL3 positivity is only one optional route into the trial (GBM enters by histology), so it does not count under D31-A2. Harmonisation: A2 confirmed (DLL3 is an 'or' route inside entry criterion 3/4, not a cohort requirement); the DLL3 row is exploratory_correlative with candidate_matched true (tarlatamab targets DLL3), which does not affect the outcomes.
